title: Osimertinib monotherapy
scope_note: This guide covers NCCP 00353 osimertinib on its own: T790M-positive advanced disease, first-line activating-EGFR advanced disease, or completely resected stage IB–IIIA Ex19del/L858R adjuvant treatment. The newer licensed post-chemoradiation setting and osimertinib with platinum/pemetrexed need their own applicable plan; their study results and support medicines are not added to this monotherapy suite.
schedule_label: Daily oral treatment without a rest week
schedule_summary: The usual starting dose is 80 mg by mouth once daily, every day without a planned rest week. Use the dose on your prescription. Advanced treatment continues while helping and tolerated; adjuvant treatment is planned for up to three years, with earlier stopping if cancer returns or side effects become unacceptable.
purpose: Osimertinib blocks abnormal EGFR growth signals in selected lung cancers. After complete surgery, treatment aims to lower the risk of cancer returning. In advanced cancer, it aims to control cancer and delay progression. Confirm which aim applies to you.
indication_text: This guide covers NCCP 00353 osimertinib on its own: T790M-positive advanced disease, first-line activating-EGFR advanced disease, or completely resected stage IB–IIIA Ex19del/L858R adjuvant treatment. The newer licensed post-chemoradiation setting and osimertinib with platinum/pemetrexed need their own applicable plan; their study results and support medicines are not added to this monotherapy suite.
administration_text: Take at the same time each day, with or without food. Swallow whole with water; do not crush, split or chew. If you forget a dose, take it when remembered unless less than 12 hours remain before the next dose, when it should be skipped. Confirm the instruction with your pharmacist if the next dose is exactly 12 hours away. Do not take an extra dose without advice if you vomit. Ask for the approved water-dispersion instructions if swallowing is difficult.
monitoring_summary: Confirm the relevant EGFR test, treatment setting and prescription. Adjuvant treatment needs complete resection and the specific stage/mutation criteria. Blood count, kidney, liver and bone profile; ECG before treatment. Consider an echocardiogram or MUGA LVEF assessment for cardiac risks or symptoms; review all medicines, pregnancy, contraception and breastfeeding. Repeat blood count, kidney, liver and bone profile at the agreed reviews; extra checks may be needed for symptoms or abnormal results. NCCP specifies ECG at baseline and cycle 2, then cycle 3 onwards if clinically indicated. The team translates cycle 2 into a booked review; the tablets remain daily, without a treatment break. LVEF assessment if clinically indicated; ECG and electrolytes with cardiac/QT risks. Scans and disease checks follow the Consultant plan.

agents.name: Osimertinib
agents.explanation: Osimertinib is an EGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitor. It blocks signalling from sensitising EGFR mutations and the T790M resistance mutation, reducing cancer-cell growth signals. The tumour test and treatment setting determine whether it is appropriate.
agents.watch: Report new breathlessness, severe rash, diarrhoea, fainting, unusual bleeding or eye pain promptly.

logistics.title: Your practical treatment plan
logistics.intro: The usual starting dose is 80 mg by mouth once daily, every day without a planned rest week. Use the dose on your prescription. sections.title: Before starting
sections.text: Confirm the exact indication and mutation, dose, baseline tests, first review and emergency contact.

sections.title: Taking the tablet
sections.text: Take at the same time each day, with or without food. Swallow whole with water; do not crush, split or chew. If you forget a dose, take it when remembered unless less than 12 hours remain before the next dose, when it should be skipped. Confirm the instruction with your pharmacist if the next dose is exactly 12 hours away. Do not take an extra dose without advice if you vomit. Ask for the approved water-dispersion instructions if swallowing is difficult.

sections.title: Supplies and visits
sections.text: Arrange repeat prescriptions before tablets run out. Keep blood and ECG appointments. The oral regimen does not itself need an infusion line or pump.

sections.title: If treatment is held
sections.text: Ask why it is held, what must recover, when review is due and who will authorise restarting. Do not choose between 80 mg and 40 mg yourself.

sections.title: At completion or change
sections.text: Agree scans, symptom follow-up, the medicine plan and contraception after the final dose.

evidence.title: Evidence depends on the treatment setting
evidence.intro: Adjuvant and advanced trials answer different questions.
evidence.population: Resected Ex19del/L858R disease; untreated advanced Ex19del/L858R disease; or advanced T790M disease after an earlier EGFR inhibitor.
evidence.interpretation: The evidence differs by setting. In a study after complete surgery, adjuvant osimertinib improved survival compared with placebo. In untreated advanced EGFR-mutated cancer, it improved survival compared with older EGFR tablets. After resistance with T790M, it delayed progression compared with platinum/pemetrexed, but the final overall-survival comparison was not statistically significant. These results describe selected study groups and cannot predict your own outcome.
evidence.limitations: Study averages cannot give an individual prognosis or compare today’s treatment options head to head. Chemotherapy-combination and post-chemoradiation studies require a separate discussion.

teachback: Can you explain your treatment aim and duration, how you take the tablet, which heart/blood tests are next, and which symptoms mean you should call today?
consent_support: Discuss adjuvant versus advanced intent, expected benefit and uncertainty, alternatives including not proceeding, common skin/bowel effects, serious lung/heart/skin/blood problems, fertility and pregnancy, daily tablets, monitoring and your right to reconsider.

support.title: Skin and nails
support.text: Agree an EGFR-inhibitor skin-care plan from the start and report rash or painful nail changes early. Blistering, peeling or mucosal sores need urgent assessment.

support.title: Bowel symptoms and hydration
support.text: Report diarrhoea early, follow the prescribed symptom plan and maintain fluids if able. Severe diarrhoea, weakness or reduced urine needs urgent advice.

support.title: Nausea medicines
support.text: Osimertinib has minimal-to-low oral emetic risk. Routine infusion premedication is not usually needed. Agree rescue medicines individually, including QT and interaction review; do not copy a chemotherapy antiemetic course.

support.title: Medicine interactions
support.text: Tell the team about all medicines and supplements. Do not take St John’s wort. Strong enzyme-inducing medicines and medicines that affect heart rhythm require pharmacy review before changes.

support.title: Pregnancy, fertility and breastfeeding
support.text: Avoid pregnancy during treatment. Effective contraception continues for at least two months after the final dose for women and four months for men. Osimertinib may reduce hormonal contraceptive effectiveness; discuss a suitable method. Do not breastfeed during treatment. Discuss fertility and plans for pregnancy before starting.

items.text: Give your medicine name, last dose and symptoms. Explain whether you can drink, pass urine and manage usual activities. Do not delay a call while collecting information.

chapters.title: What studies tell us
chapters.intro: The evidence differs by setting. In a study after complete surgery, adjuvant osimertinib improved survival compared with placebo. In untreated advanced EGFR-mutated cancer, it improved survival compared with older EGFR tablets. After resistance with T790M, it delayed progression compared with platinum/pemetrexed, but the final overall-survival comparison was not statistically significant. These results describe selected study groups and cannot predict your own outcome.

items.title: Your own decision
items.text: Ask how closely the study population matches your situation and discuss alternatives, harms and remaining uncertainty.

chapters.title: When treatment changes

items.title: Advanced disease
items.text: Continue only while benefit and tolerability remain acceptable; a new symptom or progression may change the plan.

questions.q: Do I need dates to use the timeline?
questions.a: No. It shows relative steps; your team arranges real appointments and reviews results.

questions.q: Does a rash show treatment is working?
questions.a: Side effects do not reliably show benefit. Report them; scans and clinical reviews assess cancer control.
